title: M7-07 — session_stop single-call path (one ProbeService::stop call per request)

internal_helper.enum: pub enum SessionStopPersistence (module-scope, NOT in output.rs)
variants: Stopped { session_id, events: Vec<TraceEvent>, language, target, total_events, duration_ms, ebpf_detached, sealed_at }
internal_helper.rationale: Carries Vec<TraceEvent> back to the wrapper without bloating the JSON wire shape. AlreadyStopped replaces the m7-06 StopSnapshot ProbeNotFound fallback so the dispatcher can express 'idempotent path' as a normal outcome instead of an error workaround.

new_entry_points: pub async fn stop_with_persistence(&ctx, &input) -> Result<(bool, SessionStopPersistence), ServiceError>
pub async fn stop(&ctx, &input) -> Result<SessionStopOutput, ServiceError> (now a thin synthesiser that delegates to stop_with_persistence)
removed: mark_sealed live-only edge-case handling (reverted to Result<(), ServiceError> as in m7-05)

mcp_wrapper_refactor.wrapper_now: Calls stop_with_persistence directly (NOT self.stop). On Stopped: save_session(meta, &events) then build_and_store_engine(sid, events, language). On AlreadyStopped: load_session and synthesise output. No more pre_stop double-call.

architectural_decisions.single_probe_call_site: ChronosSessionLifecycleService::stop_with_persistence is the ONLY place that calls ProbeService::stop. The MCP wrapper never calls it directly. Eliminates the m7-06 'probe-already-gone' soft-handling.
architectural_decisions.events_flow_through_internal_enum_not_dt: SessionStopPersistence is at module scope in services/src/session_lifecycle.rs (not in output.rs). External clients see only SessionStopOutput JSON which drops the events vector (would otherwise be many MB on the wire).
architectural_decisions.already_stopped_is_a_normal_outcome: Replaces the m7-06 'ProbeNotFound → load_session fallback' with a clean AlreadyStopped variant. The wrapper synthesises a SessionStopOutput with status='already_stopped' on idempotent calls.
architectural_decisions.tail_sealed_set_at_persist_time: The wrapper sets meta.tail_sealed = sealed_at.is_some() directly before save_session. No separate mark_sealed call needed (m7-05 had a load+mutate+save round-trip which is no longer required).
architectural_decisions.mark_sealed_kept_for_future: Helper preserved with #[allow(dead_code)] for any future caller that wants to seal a session without going through stop (e.g. a /seal REST endpoint or a manual post-stop seal).
architectural_decisions.status_field_gains_already_stopped_varia: Additive wire change: SessionStopOutput.status may now be 'already_stopped' in addition to 'stopped'. Old clients that check for 'stopped' continue to work (first call still returns 'stopped').

unit_tests_updated: mark_sealed_updates_metadata_and_persists (signature revert: unwrap() no longer checks bool)
sandbox_smoke_passed: session_lifecycle (8 tests; test_capabilities_static_then_dynamic_through_full_lifecycle + test_session_start_load_returns_metadata both still pass after the architectural refactor)

gates.T1_workspace_lib_ex_chronos_native: pass (798/798 + 4 ignored; same as m7-06 — no regression)
gates.T2_per_crate_integration_services_store_: pass (358/358; same as m7-06 — no regression)
gates.behaviour_change: Internal: single ProbeService::stop call (was two on the wrapper pre-stop path). External: SessionStopOutput.status field gains additive 'already_stopped' variant. No new ServiceError variants. No new Unsupported stubs.

followups.scope: Implement chronos_domain::attach API; unblocks session_start{action=attach} (currently Unsupported stub)
M8 milestone planning: live probe performance, MCP server hardening, distributed tracing
